newsitem.title: USA: MAXXAM said results hit by lower prices.
newsitem.headline: MAXXAM said results hit by lower prices.

text.p: MAXXAM Inc said its first quarter operating income was hurt by lower realized prices for alumina and fabricated aluminum products, and lower shipments of alumina.

Higher shipments of fabricated aluminum products partially offset the losses, the company said. Earnings per share for the quarter were $0.07, sharply below last year's first quarter earnings of $0.61 a share.
MAXXAM noted that its results were "much improved" from the 1996 fourth quarter when aluminum operations reported operating income of $11.8 million.
